scientific_integrity: Exact theorem about a defined cosine-wave propagator; no claim of independent validation or of a uniform-in-time weak-edge quantum-walk limit.
scientific_limitations: Only three components and positive masses/couplings.
Infinite-time supremum cannot be passed through the fixed-time small-coupling asymptotics.
Rational general maxima require a finite polynomial critical-point calculation.
Mirror-symmetric perfect-transfer parity is prior work and excluded from claimed novelty.
title: Sharp all-parameter endpoint transfer in the three-component weighted wave reduction
